title: Not all from Israel are Israel
english: [[Not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel >> Bible:Romans 9:6]]. [[Not all are children of Abraham because they are his offspring >> Bible:Romans 9:7]] — [[Through Isaac shall your offspring be named >> Bible:Romans 9:7]].

title: Mercy on whom he wills
